scripts.types: pyright --project pyrightconfig.json && tsc --project jsconfig.service-worker.json && tsc --project jsconfig.speech.json && tsc --project jsconfig.audit.json
scripts.test:static: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_static_checks.py -v && node tests/test_service_worker.cjs
scripts.coverage: python -m coverage run -m unittest tests.test_api tests.test_bucket_probe tests.test_bucket_snapshot tests.test_data_loader tests.test_downloads tests.test_indexer tests.test_full_build tests.test_parse_boundaries tests.test_proofread_boundaries tests.test_reindex_scheduler tests.test_search tests.test_search_store tests.test_stores tests.test_storage_lock tests.test_parse_core && python -m coverage report --show-missing --fail-under=80
